# W3C SHACL test fixtures

These are unmodified copies from the W3C Data Shapes test suite,
[`tests/sparql`](https://github.com/w3c/data-shapes/tree/165bd08526c3b171a9d702edb8d9cf74f7a3ade0/data-shapes-test-suite/tests/sparql),
under the W3C repository's [license](LICENSE.md). `pre-binding/` copies its
`pre-binding/` directory; `sparql/` contains its `node/`, `property/`, and
`component/` directories. The tests originate in the SHACL 1.0 suite; their
expectations are interpreted according to this project's documented profile.
